title: A modified assay for the enumeration of ascaris eggs in fresh raw sewage
author: Shahsavari, Schmidt, et al.

steps.title: Sediment raw sewage
steps.instruction: Allow 1 L raw sewage sample to sediment in its bottle overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and blend
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard supernatant leaving ~100 mL, vortex the sediment to resuspend, and transfer the suspension to a blender.

steps.title: Rinse bottle and adjust volume
steps.instruction: Rinse the sample bottle twice with ~100 mL of 1 % 7× detergent (MP Biomedicals), combine both rinses into the blender, and add sterile reagent water to reach a final volume of 300 mL if needed.

steps.title: Add antifoam and blend
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL antifoam‑B (Sigma‑Aldrich) to the sample and blend on high speed for 1 min.

steps.title: Transfer to cylinder and rinse blender
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenized sample to a 1000 mL graduated cylinder; rinse the blender twice with ~100 mL of 1 % 7× detergent, adding each rinse to the cylinder; then add additional 1 % 7× detergent to bring the total volume to ~900 mL.

steps.title: First sedimentation
steps.instruction: Allow the sample in the cylinder to sediment overnight or at least 4 h at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and re‑blend
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard supernatant leaving ~100 mL, vortex the sediment, and transfer it back to the blender.

steps.title: Rinse cylinder and adjust volume
steps.instruction: Rinse the graduated cylinder twice with ~100 mL of 1 % 7× detergent, add each rinse to the blender, and add sterile reagent water to reach 300 mL if necessary.

steps.title: Add antifoam and blend again
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL antifoam‑B and blend on high speed for 1 min.

steps.title: Repeat sediment‑blend cycle twice
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 6 through 9 two additional times, for a total of three sediment‑blend cycles.

steps.title: Final overnight sedimentation
steps.instruction: Allow the sample to sediment in the blender overnight or at least 4 h at 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect sediment in centrifuge tube
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard supernatant leaving ~100 mL, then transfer the sediment to a 250 mL conical centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Rinse blender and adjust volume
steps.instruction: Rinse the blender with ~50 mL of 1 % 7× detergent, add the rinse to the centrifuge tube, and add 1 % 7× detergent to bring the tube volume to 250 mL if needed.

steps.title: Centrifuge first pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube in a swinging‑bucket rotor at 800 × g for 10 min at ambient temperature.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard supernatant to just above the pellet.

steps.title: Transfer pellet to 50 mL tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the pellet to a 50 mL centrifuge tube; if the pellet exceeds 5 mL, split it evenly into multiple 50 mL tubes, each containing ≤5 mL.

steps.title: Add MgSO₄ and resuspend
steps.instruction: Add 50 mL MgSO₄ (specific gravity 1.25) and resuspend the pellet by vortexing.

steps.title: Centrifuge second time
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 800 × g for 10 min at ambient temperature.

steps.title: Collect egg‑containing supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant, which contains helminth eggs, to a second 250 mL conical centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Repeat pellet processing
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 16 and 17 on the remaining pellet.

steps.title: Combine egg supernatants
steps.instruction: Combine the supernatants from both extractions into the centrifuge tube used in step 18.

steps.title: Dilute and centrifuge final concentrate
steps.instruction: Add sterile reagent water to a final volume of 250 mL, then centrifuge at 800 × g for 10 min at ambient temperature.

steps.title: Discard final supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in MgSO₄
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in at least five volumes of MgSO₄ (specific gravity 1.25).

steps.title: Aliquot onto counting slide
steps.instruction: Vortex the concentrate, then pipette ~0.5 mL into each chamber of a Whitlock Universal 4‑chamber worm‑egg counting slide.

steps.title: Let eggs float
steps.instruction: Place the slide on a flat surface for 5 min to allow eggs to float to the surface.

steps.title: Examine under microscope
steps.instruction: Examine the entire slide at ≥50× magnification.
